[[Walsh Gymnasium]] | champion = | tourney = | tourney_result = }} {{2020–21 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team''' represented [[Seton Hall University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by eleventh-year head coach [[Kevin Willard]]. The Pirates played their home games at the [[Prudential Center]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]] and [[Walsh Gymnasium]] in [[South Orange, New Jersey]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they finished the season 14–13, 10–9 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a tie for fourth place. As the No. 5 seed in the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John's]] in the quarterfinals before losing to [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the semifinals. == Previous season == The [[2019–20 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Pirates]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 21–9, 13–5 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a three-way tie for first place; the program's first regular season title since [[1992–93 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|1992–93]]. However, the season ended due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic prior to playing a game in the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], which was canceled during the first quarterfinal round game, following a campaign in which the Pirates were projected to receive an at-large bid to the also-canceled [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2020 NCAA tournament]] regardless of how they fared in the Big East tournament. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
